speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe the nature of your bladder discomfort and how frequently you are urinating compared to normal. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis - Color: Clear, pH: 6.7, Specific_Gravity: 1.010, Protein: 1+, Glucose: Negative, Ketones: Negative, Blood: Negative, Nitrite: Negative, Leukocyte Esterase: Negative, WBC: 0/hpf, Squamous Epithelial Cells: 2/hpf, Bacteria: None

speaker: Patient
text: 40-year-old female. The patient reports a 5-month history of worsening bladder discomfort, which is relieved by voiding. She mentions an increased frequency of urination, voiding 10–15 times during the day and waking up 2–3 times at night to void. She denies any involuntary loss of urine. Attempts to manage the discomfort with reduced fluid intake and NSAIDs have provided minimal relief. She also reports recent painful intercourse.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Significant for bipolar disorder, currently managed with lithium. Social history: Married and sexually active with her husband. No significant alcohol, tobacco, or recreational drug use.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, hematuria, back pain, pelvic pain other than with intercourse, and any recent infections. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has your discomfort or urinary frequency worsened during or after sexual intercourse? REQUEST TEST: Urine Culture; REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_Ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis previously showed mild proteinuria (1+); Urine Culture pending; Pelvic Ultrasound shows postvoid residual urine of 25 mL with normal urethra and bladder mucosa on cystoscopy.

speaker: Doctor
text: Doctor: Have you noticed any difficulty starting your urine stream, a weak stream, or a sensation of incomplete bladder emptying? REQUEST TEST: Post-void residual measurement (confirmatory).

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any changes in your sexual function, such as erectile dysfunction, or a sensation of heaviness in the perineum? REQUEST TEST: Prostate_Special_Exam.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the frequency of your urination been accompanied by urgency, and do you experience any pain or burning during voiding specifically? REQUEST TEST: Serum_Prolactin.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any history of pelvic surgery, childbirth trauma, or neurological conditions that could affect bladder function? REQUEST TEST: MRI Pelvis.
